next.reason: 1985: "Record-name-1 and identifier-1 must not refer to the same storage area."; 2023: "14.6.10, Overlapping operands, and 14.9.25, MOVE statement, general rules, apply to any cases in which the storage area ... share". 1985 forbids shared storage outright. 2023 has no such syntax rule; it allows shared storage and leaves the result to the overlapping-operand and MOVE rules.
